2610.11754.title: What Output-Only Review Cannot Verify: Study Contracts for Research Agents
2610.11754.paper_summary: Some defects in an AI-generated study can be identified from its artifacts; others require knowledge of what was approved before execution. We propose study contracts that bind declared experimental choices, run obligations and claim scope to recorded execution evidence, and distinguish this contract-relative verification from scientific truth. A diagnostic using eight self-authored clean/mutated pairs illustrates the information boundary. A deterministic checker applying a registered, fault-specific rule to approved and executed objects detected all eight registered mutations. Across eighteen recorded judge aliases given individual metadata-filtered packages without pair context or the registry-selected fault label, 104 of 144 mutated evaluation cases received defect flags; the remaining cases comprised 32 abstentions and eight terminal failures, with no explicit clean decisions on mutated cases. Some packages retained approval and execution fields, including digests. The prompt instructed judges to abstain when evidence was insufficient. These results characterize a deliberately information-asymmetric development setting; they do not isolate the effect of authoritative information from differences in task specification and rule selection, and they are not comparative verifier quality or agent reward hacking. We identify full-information comparisons, legitimate-adaptation controls and closed-loop agent evaluations as necessary tests of whether contract checks improve useful compliant completion under optimization.
2610.11754.paper_summary_zh: 一些AI生成研究中的缺陷可以從其工件中識別出來；其他缺陷則需要了解在執行之前所批准的內容。我們提出的研究合同將已聲明的實驗選擇、執行義務和索賠範圍與記錄的執行證據綁定，並將這種合同相對的驗證與科學真理區分開來。使用八對自創的乾淨/變異對進行的診斷說明了信息邊界。一個應用註冊的、針對特定故障的確定性檢查器對已批准和執行的對象檢測到了所有八個註冊的變異。在十八個記錄的法官別名中，給予個別元數據過濾的包裹，沒有對對的背景或註冊選擇的故障標籤，144個變異評估案例中有104個收到了缺陷標記；其餘案例包括32個棄權和八個終端失敗，對變異案例沒有明確的乾淨決策。一些包裹保留了批准和執行字段，包括摘要。提示指示法官在證據不足時棄權。這些結果特徵化了一個故意的信息不對稱發展環境；它們並未將權威信息的影響與任務規範和規則選擇的差異隔離開來，且它們也不是比較驗證者質量或代理獎勵黑客。我們確定全信息比較、合法適應控制和閉環代理評估是必要的測試，以判斷合同檢查是否改善了在優化下的有用合規完成。
2610.11754.author: Eitan Waks et.al.
